import ast,json,pathlib
text=pathlib.Path('doc/05_testing/CASE_manual_acceptance.md').read_text()
section=text.split('## 剧本 4 ')[1].split('## 剧本 5 ')[0]
code=section.split("python3 - <<'PY'\n")[1].split('\nPY')[0]
tree=ast.parse(code)
assign=next(n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='family_label' for t in n.targets))
expr=compile(ast.Expression(assign.value),'<CASE4 family_label>','eval')
labels={str(v):eval(expr,{'family':v}) for v in ['unknown','same-family','different-family',True,False,None]}
assert labels['unknown']=='未知' and labels['True']=='旧版名义族判定' and labels['False']=='旧版名义族判定'
m=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/Users/chenzhenbo/Work/trivium-m11-step12-20261012/.reviews/m11-s12-capacity/plan/_meta/run-20261012T134125Z.json').read_text())
results=[]
for k,v in m['critics'].items():
 pair=next(x for x in m['family_comparisons'] if x['left']=='claude' and x['right']==k)
 assert v['heterogeneous']==pair['status']=='different-family'
 assert all(pair.get(f) for f in ['left_model','right_model','left_source','right_source','reason'])
 results.append(pair)
print(json.dumps({'labels':labels,'b1_pairs':results,'second_round':'未测','production_changed':False},ensure_ascii=False))
